resources.string: Paste a link to a public Spotify playlist. Soun finds each song on YouTube Music and saves them as a new playlist.
Spotify only shared %1$d of this playlist\'s %2$d tracks, so the rest can\'t be imported.
Spotify only shares the first %1$d tracks of a playlist, so anything after that isn\'t included.
That isn\'t a Spotify playlist link. In Spotify, open the playlist, tap Share, then Copy link, and paste it here.
Couldn\'t reach Spotify. Check your connection and try again.
Spotify couldn\'t find this playlist. Check the link and make sure the playlist is public.
This playlist is empty or private. Only public playlists can be imported.
Couldn\'t read this playlist from Spotify. Try again later.
Couldn\'t reach YouTube Music. Check your connection and try again.
None of the songs in this playlist were found on YouTube Music.
